description: This file defines the Rearrange class for the Views UI module in Drupal, providing a form for rearranging view handlers via AJAX.

classes.name: Rearrange
classes.description: Provides a form for rearranging view handlers in Drupal's Views UI via AJAX.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Rearrange form object, optionally setting the type.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Builds and returns the form for a specific view, display, and type.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs the rearrangement form with fields, relationships, and controls.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles form submission, updating the order of view fields based on user input.
